restoreTitle: Restore this version of the prompt?
restoreBody: The current version is saved to the history first, so you can go back to it.

learning.title: What you reject when reviewing
learning.empty: No block reviews yet. When you review plans from the "Review changes" tab, you'll see here which kinds of writer changes you discard most.
learning.append: Append it to the end of the prompt to review it →
learning.none: No kind of change is rejected enough (at least {min} cases and {ratio}% rejection) to suggest a rule.

appended: The suggested text was appended at the end. Review and adjust it before saving.

notices.saved: Prompt saved. It will be used in the next plans.
notices.reset: The factory prompt is used again. Your version stays in the history.

noRevisions: No saved versions yet: one is created the first time you save.
metaCustomized: Your version is used, saved in {path}. The factory prompt stays untouched.
metaFactory: The factory prompt is used. Saving creates your version. The factory one isn't modified and you can go back to it any time.
warning: This affects ALL future plans for this prompt. The writer has rules calibrated against real failures -- edit with care.
historyNote: Each save keeps the previous version in the history.
resetTitle: Go back to the factory prompt?
resetBody: Your version stops being used. It stays saved in the history and you can restore it from there.
